description: This file is a shell script used for controlling and querying the status LED indicators on a device. It defines functions to identify the appropriate status LED and to set its state based on different system events.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Identifies the appropriate status LED file path based on power indicator attributes and sets 'status_led' variable.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED state based on the provided argument, calling functions for blinking or turning the LED on.
